urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Web pages to capture. "example.com" without https:// works too.

html.title: Raw HTML (optional)
html.description: HTML to render instead of (or in addition to) URLs — e.g. an invoice or report template to turn into PDF. External images and styles referenced by absolute https URLs are loaded.

format.title: Output format
format.description: png, jpeg, webp — screenshot; pdf — printable PDF of the page.

device.title: Device
device.description: desktop 1920×1080, laptop 1366×768, tablet iPad Pro 11, mobile iPhone 15 Pro, android Galaxy S24 (phones and tablets at their real pixel density).

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page (up to 20,000 px high), not just the first screen.

selector.title: Element (CSS selector)
selector.description: Capture only this element, e.g. #pricing or .chart. Empty = whole page.

hideCookieBanners.title: Hide cookie banners
hideCookieBanners.description: Hide floating cookie and consent banners (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi and similar).

scrollToBottom.title: Load lazy images
scrollToBottom.description: Scroll through the page before capturing so lazy-loaded images appear.

waitUntil.title: Wait until
waitUntil.description: load = page and images loaded (default); networkidle = no network activity for 0.5 s (single-page apps); domcontentloaded = fastest.

delayMs.title: Extra delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Wait this long before capturing (animations, charts).

viewportWidth.title: Viewport width (desktop/laptop)
viewportWidth.description: Custom width in pixels; 0 = device default.

viewportHeight.title: Viewport height (desktop/laptop)
viewportHeight.description: Custom height in pixels; 0 = device default.

darkMode.title: Dark mode
darkMode.description: Ask the site for its dark theme (prefers-color-scheme: dark).

css.title: Custom CSS (optional)
css.description: Injected before capturing, e.g. to hide chat widgets: .intercom-launcher{display:none!important}

pdfScreenMedia.title: PDF looks like the screen
pdfScreenMedia.description: Off = the site's print styles (clean, no menus); on = exactly as on screen.

timeoutSecs.title: Page timeout (s)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a page that does not load in this time (not charged).
